entries.content:
Amurelys was raised by her parents, Anrio and Salena Picanté, alongside her many siblings. Out of her forty-something siblings, Amurelys is the sixth, having five older brothers (Amen, Dios, Ryli, Ren, and Jako, respectively). Some of her younger siblings include her sisters, Kiana, Yanilsa, and Brendi, as well as some of her younger brothers, Yomé, Tito, and Andres.

At the age of sixteen, Amurelys had her firstborn child, her eldest son, Yani (22). After him, she had nine more: her eldest daughter, Dianys (20); twin daughters, Amor and Amez (Ah-mehz) (19); second son, Mori (17), third son, Ramil (16), fourth daughter, Mina (15); twin son and daughter, Echo and Aiya (12); and her youngest son and child, Mezzo (8). All of her children were fathered by her ex-boyfriend, Kihaté Hernandez, with whom she raises together just fine. Her first five children (Yani, Dianys, Amor, Amez and Mori) all have her last name, Picanté; the last five children (Ramil, Mina, Echo, Aiya and Mezzo) all have their father’s, Hernandez.

From her many siblings, Amurelys likewise has many, many nieces and nephews. Some of her family live in other places all over the world.
